questions.prompt: If you fix the three ShellCheck findings in `model-output.sh`, what is the security status of the script?

options.b: It remains command-injectable through its user-supplied `$FILTER` argument passed to `eval`
options.c: It will fail to execute under Bash 5

questions.prompt: Why is a spec that permits a user-supplied jq filter string dangerous?

options.a: It designs command injection into the architecture, regardless of how carefully variables are quoted
options.b: JQ expressions cannot process JSON files

questions.prompt: What happens when a script repeatedly appends (`>>`) to a fixed temporary file path across runs?

options.a: Stale output from previous runs accumulates and corrupts subsequent event counts
options.b: The operating system automatically truncates the file
options.c: The script throws a file access error
